# Create 1. termux_civilization_setup.sh - Complete Termux setup script
setup_script = """#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# THE NEW CIVILIZATION - TERMUX SETUP SCRIPT
# Complete environment setup for Hugging Face-powered AI civilization
# =============================================================================

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Colors for output
RED='\\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\\033[0;34m'
PURPLE='\\033[0;35m'
CYAN='\\033[0;36m'
NC='\\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${PURPLE}🚀 THE NEW CIVILIZATION - SETUP INITIALIZING${NC}"
echo -e "${CYAN}===============================================${NC}"

# Function to print status
print_status() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[✓]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[⚠]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} $1"
}

print_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[ℹ]${NC} $1"
}

# Check if running in Termux
if [[ ! -d "/data/data/com.termux" ]]; then
    print_error "This script must be run in Termux environment!"
    exit 1
fi

print_status "Running in Termux environment ✓"

# Update and upgrade Termux packages
print_info "Updating Termux packages..."
pkg update -y && pkg upgrade -y
print_status "Termux packages updated"

# Install essential packages
print_info "Installing essential packages..."
pkg install -y \\
    python \\
    python-pip \\
    git \\
    curl \\
    wget \\
    nodejs \\
    nano \\
    vim \\
    openssh \\
    rsync \\
    jq \\
    tree \\
    htop \\
    termux-api

print_status "Essential packages installed"

# Setup storage access
print_info "Setting up storage access..."
termux-setup-storage
print_status "Storage access configured"

# Install Python packages for The New Civilization
print_info "Installing Python packages for AI civilization..."
pip install --upgrade pip

# Core Hugging Face packages
pip install \\
    huggingface-hub \\
    transformers \\
    datasets \\
    gradio \\
    accelerate \\
    peft \\
    bitsandbytes \\
    torch \\
    torchaudio \\
    torchvision

# Additional AI/ML packages
pip install \\
    numpy \\
    pandas \\
    scikit-learn \\
    matplotlib \\
    seaborn \\
    plotly \\
    jupyter \\
    ipywidgets

# Business and automation packages
pip install \\
    requests \\
    aiohttp \\
    fastapi \\
    uvicorn \\
    python-dotenv \\
    pydantic \\
    sqlalchemy \\
    redis \\
    celery

# Specialized packages
pip install \\
    langchain \\
    openai \\
    anthropic \\
    sentence-transformers \\
    faiss-cpu \\
    chromadb \\
    wandb \\
    tensorboard

print_status "Python packages installed"

# Create project structure
print_info "Creating The New Civilization project structure..."
cd ~/storage/shared
mkdir -p new_civilization_hf/{scripts,config,agents,models,data,deployments,logs,docs,spaces,hub_repos}

# Create configuration files
print_info "Creating configuration templates..."
cat > ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/config/civilization.env << 'EOF'
# =============================================================================
# THE NEW CIVILIZATION - CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

# Hugging Face Configuration
HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=your_huggingface_token_here
HF_HOME=~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/models
HF_CACHE_DIR=~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/models/cache

# Spaces Configuration  
SPACES_BASE_URL=https://huggingface.co/spaces
SPACES_API_URL=https://huggingface.co/api/spaces

# Hub Configuration
HUB_BASE_URL=https://huggingface.co
HUB_API_URL=https://huggingface.co/api

# Business Configuration
CIVILIZATION_NAME="The New Civilization"
ORGANIZATION_NAME="your_hf_organization"
BASE_REVENUE_TARGET=10000
SCALING_FACTOR=2.0

# Agent Configuration
MAX_AGENTS=10
AGENT_COMMUNICATION_PORT=8080
COORDINATION_INTERVAL=30

# Model Configuration
DEFAULT_MODEL_SIZE="small"
TRAINING_BATCH_SIZE=4
LEARNING_RATE=0.0001
MAX_EPOCHS=10

# Deployment Configuration
AUTO_DEPLOY=true
DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT="production"
MONITORING_ENABLED=true
BACKUP_ENABLED=true

# Logging Configuration
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
LOG_FILE=~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/logs/civilization.log
MAX_LOG_SIZE=10MB
LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=30
EOF

# Create startup script
cat > ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/startup.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# The New Civilization - Startup Script

source ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/config/civilization.env

echo "🚀 Starting The New Civilization..."
echo "🤖 Initializing AI agents..."
echo "📡 Connecting to Hugging Face Hub..."
echo "💼 Starting business engines..."
echo "🌐 Deploying civilization infrastructure..."

# Start the main orchestrator
cd ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf
python scripts/civilization_hf_orchestrator.py

echo "✅ The New Civilization is now operational!"
EOF

chmod +x ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/startup.sh

print_status "Configuration files created"

# Setup Git (if not already configured)
print_info "Configuring Git..."
if ! git config --global user.name > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Enter your name for Git configuration:"
    read -r git_name
    git config --global user.name "$git_name"
fi

if ! git config --global user.email > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Enter your email for Git configuration:"
    read -r git_email
    git config --global user.email "$git_email"
fi

print_status "Git configured"

# Create SSH key for secure operations (optional)
print_info "Setting up SSH key (optional)..."
if [[ ! -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa ]]; then
    echo "Generate SSH key? (y/n):"
    read -r ssh_choice
    if [[ "$ssh_choice" == "y" ]]; then
        ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "civilization@termux"
        print_status "SSH key generated"
        print_warning "Add the public key to your Git provider:"
        cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
    fi
fi

# Final setup verification
print_info "Verifying installation..."
python_version=$(python --version)
git_version=$(git --version)
node_version=$(node --version)

print_status "Python: $python_version"
print_status "Git: $git_version" 
print_status "Node.js: $node_version"

# Display next steps
echo -e "${PURPLE}===============================================${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 THE NEW CIVILIZATION SETUP COMPLETE! 🎉${NC}"
echo -e "${PURPLE}===============================================${NC}"
echo ""
echo -e "${CYAN}📋 NEXT STEPS:${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}1.${NC} Edit config: nano ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/config/civilization.env"
echo -e "${YELLOW}2.${NC} Add your Hugging Face token"
echo -e "${YELLOW}3.${NC} Run startup: ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf/startup.sh"
echo -e "${YELLOW}4.${NC} Build your civilization: cd ~/storage/shared/new_civilization_hf"
echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}🌟 Ready to revolutionize AI civilization! 🌟${NC}"
"""

with open('scripts/termux_civilization_setup.sh', 'w') as f:
    f.write(setup_script)

print("✅ Created: scripts/termux_civilization_setup.sh")
print("📝 Complete Termux setup script with all dependencies and configurations")

orchestrator_code = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - HUGGING FACE ORCHESTRATOR
=================================================
Main orchestration system for Hugging Face-powered AI civilization.
Coordinates all agents, models, deployments, and business operations.

Author: The New Civilization Development Team
License: MIT
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import logging
import asyncio
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, ProcessPoolExecutor
import signal

# Core imports
import requests
from huggingface_hub import HfApi, login, logout
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, pipeline
import gradio as gr

# Configuration and utilities
from dotenv import load_dotenv


@dataclass
class CivilizationConfig:
    """Configuration management for The New Civilization"""
    
    # Hugging Face Configuration
    hf_token: str = ""
    hf_home: str = ""
    hf_cache_dir: str = ""
    
    # Civilization Configuration
    civilization_name: str = "The New Civilization"
    organization_name: str = ""
    base_revenue_target: float = 10000.0
    scaling_factor: float = 2.0
    
    # Agent Configuration
    max_agents: int = 10
    agent_communication_port: int = 8080
    coordination_interval: int = 30
    
    # Model Configuration
    default_model_size: str = "small"
    training_batch_size: int = 4
    learning_rate: float = 0.0001
    max_epochs: int = 10
    
    # Deployment Configuration
    auto_deploy: bool = True
    deployment_environment: str = "production"
    monitoring_enabled: bool = True
    backup_enabled: bool = True
    
    # Logging Configuration
    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_file: str = "logs/civilization.log"
    max_log_size: str = "10MB"
    log_retention_days: int = 30


class CivilizationLogger:
    """Advanced logging system for The New Civilization"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: CivilizationConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.setup_logging()
    
    def setup_logging(self):
        """Setup comprehensive logging configuration"""
        # Create logs directory if it doesn't exist
        log_dir = Path(self.config.log_file).parent
        log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Configure logging
        logging.basicConfig(
            level=getattr(logging, self.config.log_level),
            format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
            handlers=[
                logging.FileHandler(self.config.log_file),
                logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
            ]
        )
        
        self.logger = logging.getLogger('civilization')
        self.logger.info("🚀 The New Civilization Logger Initialized")
    
    def log_agent_action(self, agent_id: str, action: str, details: dict = None):
        """Log agent actions with structured data"""
        log_data = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'agent_id': agent_id,
            'action': action,
            'details': details or {}
        }
        self.logger.info(f"AGENT_ACTION: {json.dumps(log_data)}")
    
    def log_business_metric(self, metric_name: str, value: float, metadata: dict = None):
        """Log business metrics for analysis"""
        log_data = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'metric': metric_name,
            'value': value,
            'metadata': metadata or {}
        }
        self.logger.info(f"BUSINESS_METRIC: {json.dumps(log_data)}")
    
    def log_model_operation(self, operation: str, model_name: str, result: dict = None):
        """Log model training/deployment operations"""
        log_data = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'operation': operation,
            'model_name': model_name,
            'result': result or {}
        }
        self.logger.info(f"MODEL_OPERATION: {json.dumps(log_data)}")


class HuggingFaceManager:
    """Manages all Hugging Face operations"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: CivilizationConfig, logger: CivilizationLogger):
        self.config = config
        self.logger = logger
        self.api = None
        self.authenticated = False
        self.models_cache = {}
        self.spaces_cache = {}
        
    async def authenticate(self):
        """Authenticate with Hugging Face Hub"""
        try:
            if self.config.hf_token:
                login(token=self.config.hf_token)
                self.api = HfApi(token=self.config.hf_token)
                self.authenticated = True
                self.logger.logger.info("✅ Authenticated with Hugging Face Hub")
                return True
            else:
                self.logger.logger.error("❌ No Hugging Face token provided")
                return False
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.logger.error(f"❌ Authentication failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    async def list_available_models(self, filter_criteria: dict = None) -> List[dict]:
        """List available models with filtering"""
        try:
            if not self.authenticated:
                await self.authenticate()
            
            models = list(self.api.list_models(
                filter=filter_criteria.get('filter') if filter_criteria else None,
                sort="downloads",
                direction=-1,
                limit=50
            ))
            
            model_list = []
            for model in models:
                model_info = {
                    'name': model.id,
                    'downloads': getattr(model, 'downloads', 0),
                    'likes': getattr(model, 'likes', 0),
                    'tags': getattr(model, 'tags', []),
                    'pipeline_tag': getattr(model, 'pipeline_tag', 'unknown')
                }
                model_list.append(model_info)
            
            self.models_cache = {model['name']: model for model in model_list}
            self.logger.logger.info(f"📋 Found {len(model_list)} available models")
            return model_list
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to list models: {e}")
            return []
    
    async def create_model_pipeline(self, model_name: str, task: str = None) -> Optional[Any]:
        """Create a model pipeline for inference"""
        try:
            if task:
                pipe = pipeline(task, model=model_name)
            else:
                pipe = pipeline(model=model_name)
            
            self.logger.log_model_operation(
                "pipeline_created",
                model_name,
                {"task": task, "status": "success"}
            )
            return pipe
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to create pipeline for {model_name}: {e}")
            self.logger.log_model_operation(
                "pipeline_failed",
                model_name,
                {"error": str(e)}
            )
            return None
    
    async def deploy_to_spaces(self, space_config: dict) -> bool:
        """Deploy application to Hugging Face Spaces"""
        try:
            # This would integrate with spaces_deployment_manager.py
            self.logger.logger.info(f"🚀 Deploying to Spaces: {space_config['name']}")
            # Implementation would go here
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.logger.error(f"❌ Spaces deployment failed: {e}")
            return False

    """Manages business operations and revenue generation"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: CivilizationConfig, logger: CivilizationLogger):
        self.config = config
        self.logger = logger
        self.revenue_streams = {}
        self.active_services = {}
        self.client_database = {}
        
    async def initialize_revenue_streams(self):
        """Initialize various revenue generation streams"""
        revenue_streams = {
            'model_inference_api': {
                'name': 'Model Inference API',

        try:

# Create 3. ai_model_trainer.py - Custom model training and fine-tuning pipeline
trainer_code = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - AI MODEL TRAINER
========================================
Advanced model training and fine-tuning pipeline for custom AI models.
Supports various training strategies including LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tuning.

Author: The New Civilization Development Team  
License: MIT
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import torch
import logging
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Union, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

# Core ML imports
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from datasets import Dataset, DatasetDict, load_dataset
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
    TrainingArguments, Trainer, DataCollatorForLanguageModeling,
    pipeline, EarlyStoppingCallback
)

# Advanced training imports
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model, TaskType, prepare_model_for_kbit_training
from accelerate import Accelerator
import bitsandbytes as bnb

# Hugging Face integration
from huggingface_hub import HfApi, create_repo, upload_folder
import wandb

# Utilities
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_recall_fscore_support
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader


@dataclass
class ModelTrainingConfig:
    """Configuration for model training operations"""
    
    # Model Configuration
    base_model_name: str = "microsoft/DialoGPT-small"
    model_type: str = "causal_lm"  # causal_lm, sequence_classification, etc.
    max_length: int = 512
    
    # Training Configuration
    training_strategy: str = "lora"  # full, lora, qlora
    learning_rate: float = 5e-5
    batch_size: int = 4
    gradient_accumulation_steps: int = 4
    num_epochs: int = 3
    warmup_steps: int = 100
    
    # LoRA Configuration
    lora_r: int = 16
    lora_alpha: int = 32
    lora_dropout: float = 0.1
    lora_target_modules: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["q_proj", "v_proj"])
    
    # QLoRA Configuration
    use_4bit: bool = False
    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype: str = "float16"
    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant: bool = True
    bnb_4bit_quant_type: str = "nf4"
    
    # Data Configuration
    dataset_name: Optional[str] = None
    dataset_path: Optional[str] = None
    train_split: str = "train"
    eval_split: str = "validation"
    test_split: str = "test"
    
    # Output Configuration
    output_dir: str = "models/trained_models"
    hub_model_id: Optional[str] = None
    push_to_hub: bool = False
    
    # Monitoring Configuration
    use_wandb: bool = False
    wandb_project: str = "new_civilization_training"
    early_stopping_patience: int = 3
    eval_steps: int = 500
    save_steps: int = 500
    logging_steps: int = 100


class DataProcessor:
    """Advanced data processing for model training"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ModelTrainingConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.tokenizer = None
        
    def load_tokenizer(self, model_name: str = None):
        """Load tokenizer for the specified model"""
        model_name = model_name or self.config.base_model_name
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
        
        # Add padding token if not present
        if self.tokenizer.pad_token is None:
            self.tokenizer.pad_token = self.tokenizer.eos_token
        
        return self.tokenizer
    
    def load_dataset_from_hub(self, dataset_name: str = None) -> DatasetDict:
        """Load dataset from Hugging Face Hub"""
        dataset_name = dataset_name or self.config.dataset_name
        if not dataset_name:
            raise ValueError("No dataset name provided")
        
        try:
            dataset = load_dataset(dataset_name)
            return dataset
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to load dataset {dataset_name}: {e}")
            raise
    
    def load_dataset_from_file(self, file_path: str = None) -> Dataset:
        """Load dataset from local file"""
        file_path = file_path or self.config.dataset_path
        if not file_path or not os.path.exists(file_path):
            raise ValueError(f"Dataset file not found: {file_path}")
        
        if file_path.endswith('.json'):
            with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        elif file_path.endswith('.csv'):
            data = pd.read_csv(file_path).to_dict('records')
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {file_path}")
        
        return Dataset.from_list(data)
    
    def preprocess_for_causal_lm(self, examples: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Preprocess data for causal language modeling"""
        if not self.tokenizer:
            raise ValueError("Tokenizer not loaded")
        
        # Handle different input formats
        if 'text' in examples:
            texts = examples['text']
        elif 'input' in examples and 'output' in examples:
            texts = [f"{inp} {out}" for inp, out in zip(examples['input'], examples['output'])]
        else:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported data format for causal LM")
        
        # Tokenize
        tokenized = self.tokenizer(
            texts,
            truncation=True,
            padding=True,
            max_length=self.config.max_length,
            return_tensors="pt"
        )
        
        # For causal LM, labels are the same as input_ids
        tokenized["labels"] = tokenized["input_ids"].clone()
        
        return tokenized
    
    def preprocess_for_classification(self, examples: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Preprocess data for sequence classification"""
        if not self.tokenizer:
            raise ValueError("Tokenizer not loaded")
        
        texts = examples['text'] if 'text' in examples else examples['input']
        labels = examples['label'] if 'label' in examples else examples['target']
        
        tokenized = self.tokenizer(
            texts,
            truncation=True,
            padding=True,
            max_length=self.config.max_length,
            return_tensors="pt"
        )
        
        tokenized["labels"] = torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
        
        return tokenized
    
    def create_conversation_dataset(self, conversations: List[Dict]) -> Dataset:
        """Create dataset from conversation data"""
        formatted_data = []
        
        for conv in conversations:
            if 'messages' in conv:
                # Multi-turn conversation format
                conversation_text = ""
                for msg in conv['messages']:
                    role = msg.get('role', 'user')
                    content = msg.get('content', '')
                    conversation_text += f"{role}: {content}\\n"
                
                formatted_data.append({
                    'text': conversation_text.strip(),
                    'conversation_id': conv.get('id', len(formatted_data))
                })
            else:
                # Simple input-output format
                formatted_data.append({
                    'text': f"User: {conv.get('input', '')}\\nAssistant: {conv.get('output', '')}",
                    'conversation_id': len(formatted_data)
                })
        
        return Dataset.from_list(formatted_data)


class ModelTrainer:
    """Advanced model trainer with support for various training strategies"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ModelTrainingConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.model = None
        self.tokenizer = None
        self.trainer = None
        self.accelerator = Accelerator()
        
        # Setup logging
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
        
    def setup_wandb(self):
        """Setup Weights & Biases for experiment tracking"""
        if self.config.use_wandb:
            wandb.init(
                project=self.config.wandb_project,
                config=self.config.__dict__,
                name=f"training_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
            )
    
    def load_model_and_tokenizer(self):
        """Load model and tokenizer based on configuration"""
        self.logger.info(f"Loading model: {self.config.base_model_name}")
        
        # Load tokenizer
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.config.base_model_name)
        if self.tokenizer.pad_token is None:
            self.tokenizer.pad_token = self.tokenizer.eos_token
        
        # Load model based on type
        if self.config.model_type == "causal_lm":
            if self.config.training_strategy == "qlora" and self.config.use_4bit:
                # QLoRA configuration
                from transformers import BitsAndBytesConfig
                
                bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(
                    load_in_4bit=True,
                    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=self.config.bnb_4bit_use_double_quant,
                    bnb_4bit_quant_type=self.config.bnb_4bit_quant_type,
                    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=getattr(torch, self.config.bnb_4bit_compute_dtype)
                )
                
                self.model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
                    self.config.base_model_name,
                    quantization_config=bnb_config,
                    device_map="auto",
                    trust_remote_code=True
                )
            else:
                self.model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
                    self.config.base_model_name,
                    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
                    device_map="auto"
                )
        
        elif self.config.model_type == "sequence_classification":
            self.model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
                self.config.base_model_name
            )
        
        # Setup PEFT if using LoRA or QLoRA
        if self.config.training_strategy in ["lora", "qlora"]:
            self._setup_peft()
        
        self.logger.info("Model and tokenizer loaded successfully")
    
    def _setup_peft(self):
        """Setup Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)"""
        if self.config.training_strategy == "qlora":
            self.model = prepare_model_for_kbit_training(self.model)
        
        # Configure LoRA
        if self.config.model_type == "causal_lm":
            task_type = TaskType.CAUSAL_LM
        elif self.config.model_type == "sequence_classification":
            task_type = TaskType.SEQ_CLS
        else:
            task_type = TaskType.FEATURE_EXTRACTION
        
        peft_config = LoraConfig(
            task_type=task_type,
            inference_mode=False,
            r=self.config.lora_r,
            lora_alpha=self.config.lora_alpha,
            lora_dropout=self.config.lora_dropout,
            target_modules=self.config.lora_target_modules,
        )
        
        self.model = get_peft_model(self.model, peft_config)
        self.model.print_trainable_parameters()
    
    def prepare_training_arguments(self) -> TrainingArguments:
        """Prepare training arguments"""
        return TrainingArguments(
            output_dir=self.config.output_dir,
            per_device_train_batch_size=self.config.batch_size,
            per_device_eval_batch_size=self.config.batch_size,
            gradient_accumulation_steps=self.config.gradient_accumulation_steps,
            learning_rate=self.config.learning_rate,
            num_train_epochs=self.config.num_epochs,
            warmup_steps=self.config.warmup_steps,
            logging_steps=self.config.logging_steps,
            eval_steps=self.config.eval_steps,
            save_steps=self.config.save_steps,
            evaluation_strategy="steps",
            save_strategy="steps",
            load_best_model_at_end=True,
            metric_for_best_model="eval_loss",
            greater_is_better=False,
            push_to_hub=self.config.push_to_hub,
            hub_model_id=self.config.hub_model_id,
            report_to="wandb" if self.config.use_wandb else None,
            remove_unused_columns=False,
        )
    
    def create_trainer(self, train_dataset: Dataset, eval_dataset: Dataset = None) -> Trainer:
        """Create Hugging Face Trainer"""
        training_args = self.prepare_training_arguments()
        
        # Data collator
        if self.config.model_type == "causal_lm":
            data_collator = DataCollatorForLanguageModeling(
                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                mlm=False,  # Causal LM, not masked LM
            )
        else:
            data_collator = None
        
        # Callbacks
        callbacks = []
        if eval_dataset and self.config.early_stopping_patience > 0:
            callbacks.append(
                EarlyStoppingCallback(
                    early_stopping_patience=self.config.early_stopping_patience
                )
            )
        
        self.trainer = Trainer(
            model=self.model,
            args=training_args,
            train_dataset=train_dataset,
            eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
            tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
            data_collator=data_collator,
            callbacks=callbacks,
        )
        
        return self.trainer
    
    def compute_metrics(self, eval_pred):
        """Compute evaluation metrics"""
        predictions, labels = eval_pred
        
        if self.config.model_type == "sequence_classification":
            predictions = np.argmax(predictions, axis=1)
            accuracy = accuracy_score(labels, predictions)
            precision, recall, f1, _ = precision_recall_fscore_support(
                labels, predictions, average='weighted'
            )
            
            return {
                'accuracy': accuracy,
                'f1': f1,
                'precision': precision,
                'recall': recall
            }
        else:
            # For causal LM, compute perplexity
            predictions = predictions[0] if isinstance(predictions, tuple) else predictions
            loss = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(
                torch.tensor(predictions).view(-1, predictions.shape[-1]),
                torch.tensor(labels).view(-1),
                ignore_index=-100
            )
            perplexity = torch.exp(loss)
            
            return {'perplexity': perplexity.item()}
    
    async def train_model(self, train_dataset: Dataset, eval_dataset: Dataset = None) -> Dict:
        """Train the model with the given datasets"""
        self.logger.info("Starting model training...")
        
        # Setup monitoring
        self.setup_wandb()
        
        # Load model and tokenizer
        self.load_model_and_tokenizer()
        
        # Create trainer
        trainer = self.create_trainer(train_dataset, eval_dataset)
        
        # Start training
        start_time = time.time()
        training_result = trainer.train()
        training_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        # Save the model
        trainer.save_model()
        
        # Push to hub if configured
        if self.config.push_to_hub and self.config.hub_model_id:
            trainer.push_to_hub()
        
        # Compile results
        results = {
            'training_loss': training_result.training_loss,
            'training_time': training_time,
            'epochs_completed': training_result.epoch,
            'steps_completed': training_result.global_step,
        }
        
        if eval_dataset:
            eval_results = trainer.evaluate()
            results.update(eval_results)
        
        self.logger.info(f"Training completed in {training_time:.2f} seconds")
        self.logger.info(f"Final training loss: {training_result.training_loss:.4f}")
        
        return results
    
    def save_model_to_hub(self, model_name: str, private: bool = False):
        """Save trained model to Hugging Face Hub"""
        try:
            if self.model and self.tokenizer:
                # Create repository
                api = HfApi()
                repo_url = create_repo(
                    model_name,
                    private=private,
                    exist_ok=True
                )
                
                # Save model and tokenizer
                self.model.save_pretrained(f"./temp_model_{model_name}")
                self.tokenizer.save_pretrained(f"./temp_model_{model_name}")
                
                # Upload to hub
                upload_folder(
                    folder_path=f"./temp_model_{model_name}",
                    repo_id=model_name,
                    repo_type="model"
                )
                
                self.logger.info(f"Model uploaded to: https://huggingface.co/{model_name}")
                return True
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to upload model: {e}")
            return False


class TrainingPipeline:
    """Complete training pipeline for The New Civilization"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ModelTrainingConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.data_processor = DataProcessor(config)
        self.trainer = ModelTrainer(config)
        
    async def run_training_pipeline(self, data_source: Union[str, Dict, List]) -> Dict:
        """Run complete training pipeline"""
        try:
            # Step 1: Prepare data
            if isinstance(data_source, str):
                if data_source.startswith('http') or '/' in data_source:
                    # Hugging Face dataset
                    dataset = self.data_processor.load_dataset_from_hub(data_source)
                    train_dataset = dataset[self.config.train_split]
                    eval_dataset = dataset.get(self.config.eval_split)
                else:
                    # Local file
                    full_dataset = self.data_processor.load_dataset_from_file(data_source)
                    # Split dataset if no eval split
                    split_dataset = full_dataset.train_test_split(test_size=0.1)
                    train_dataset = split_dataset['train']
                    eval_dataset = split_dataset['test']
            
            elif isinstance(data_source, list):
                # Conversation data
                full_dataset = self.data_processor.create_conversation_dataset(data_source)
                split_dataset = full_dataset.train_test_split(test_size=0.1)
                train_dataset = split_dataset['train']
                eval_dataset = split_dataset['test']
            
            # Step 2: Preprocess data
            self.data_processor.load_tokenizer()
            
            if self.config.model_type == "causal_lm":
                train_dataset = train_dataset.map(
                    self.data_processor.preprocess_for_causal_lm,
                    batched=True
                )
                if eval_dataset:
                    eval_dataset = eval_dataset.map(
                        self.data_processor.preprocess_for_causal_lm,
                        batched=True
                    )
            elif self.config.model_type == "sequence_classification":
                train_dataset = train_dataset.map(
                    self.data_processor.preprocess_for_classification,
                    batched=True
                )
                if eval_dataset:
                    eval_dataset = eval_dataset.map(
                        self.data_processor.preprocess_for_classification,
                        batched=True
                    )
            
            # Step 3: Train model
            results = await self.trainer.train_model(train_dataset, eval_dataset)
            
            # Step 4: Save results
            self._save_training_results(results)
            
            return results
            
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Training pipeline failed: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _save_training_results(self, results: Dict):
        """Save training results to file"""
        results_file = os.path.join(self.config.output_dir, "training_results.json")
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(results_file), exist_ok=True)
        
        with open(results_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2, default=str)

        if not self.api:
            self.logger.warning("No Hugging Face token provided. Some operations may fail.")
    
    def validate_space_config(self, config: SpaceConfig) -> bool:
        """Validate Space configuration"""
        errors = []
        
        if not config.space_name:
            errors.append("Space name is required")
        
        if not config.space_name.replace('-', '').replace('_', '').isalnum():
            errors.append("Space name must be alphanumeric (with hyphens/underscores)")
        
        if config.sdk not in ['gradio', 'streamlit', 'static']:
            errors.append("SDK must be 'gradio', 'streamlit', or 'static'")
        
        if not config.app_file:
            errors.append("App file is required")
        
        if errors:
            for error in errors:
                self.logger.error(f"Validation error: {error}")
            return False
        
        return True
    
    def create_space_repository(self, config: SpaceConfig) -> bool:
        """Create a new Space repository on Hugging Face"""
        if not self.api:
            self.logger.error("Hugging Face API not available")
            return False
        
        try:
            self.logger.info(f"Creating Space repository: {config.space_name}")
            
            repo_url = create_repo(
                repo_id=config.space_name,
                repo_type="space",
                private=config.space_private,
                exist_ok=True,
                space_sdk=config.sdk,
                token=self.hf_token
            )
            
            self.logger.info(f"Space repository created: {repo_url}")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to create Space repository: {e}")
            return False

        """Prepare Space files in a temporary directory"""
        
        # Create temporary directory
        temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="space_deployment_")
        config.temp_dir = temp_dir
        
        try:
            # Write all files
            for filename, content in files.items():
                file_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, filename)
                
                # Create subdirectories if needed
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(file_path), exist_ok=True)
                
                with open(file_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(content)
                
                self.logger.info(f"Created file: {filename}")
            
            # Create .gitignore if not present
            gitignore_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, '.gitignore')
            if not os.path.exists(gitignore_path):
                gitignore_content = """__pycache__/
*.pyc
*.pyo
*.pyd
.Python
env/
venv/
.env
.venv
pip-log.txt
pip-delete-this-directory.txt
.tox
.coverage
.coverage.*
.cache
nosetests.xml
coverage.xml
*.cover
*.log
.git
.mypy_cache
.pytest_cache
.hypothesis
flagged/
"""
                with open(gitignore_path, 'w') as f:
                    f.write(gitignore_content)
            
            self.logger.info(f"Space files prepared in: {temp_dir}")
            return temp_dir
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to prepare Space files: {e}")
            # Clean up on error
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
            raise

            errors.append("Space name must be alphanumeric (with hyphens/underscores)")

            errors.append("SDK must be 'gradio', 'streamlit', or 'static'")

            return False
        
        return True

        """Create a new Space repository on Hugging Face"""
        if not self.api:

        try:
            # Write all files
            for filename, content in files.items():
                file_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, filename)
                
                # Create subdirectories if needed
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(file_path), exist_ok=True)

class RevenueTracker:
    """Track and analyze revenue metrics"""
    
    def __init__(self, data_file: str = "data/revenue_data.json"):
        self.data_file = data_file
        self.transactions = []
        self.monthly_stats = {}
        self.load_data()
        
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def load_data(self):
        """Load revenue data from file"""
        try:
            if os.path.exists(self.data_file):
                with open(self.data_file, 'r') as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    self.transactions = data.get('transactions', [])
                    self.monthly_stats = data.get('monthly_stats', {})
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to load revenue data: {e}")
    
    def save_data(self):
        """Save revenue data to file"""
        try:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.data_file), exist_ok=True)
            data = {
                'transactions': self.transactions,
                'monthly_stats': self.monthly_stats,
                'last_updated': datetime.now().isoformat()
            }
            with open(self.data_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2, default=str)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to save revenue data: {e}")
    
    def record_transaction(self, client_id: str, service_name: str, 
                          amount: float, metadata: Dict = None):
        """Record a new revenue transaction"""
        transaction = {
            'transaction_id': f"txn_{int(time.time())}_{client_id}",
            'client_id': client_id,
            'service_name': service_name,
            'amount': amount,
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'metadata': metadata or {}
        }
        
        self.transactions.append(transaction)
        self.update_monthly_stats(amount)
        self.save_data()
        
        self.logger.info(f"💰 Revenue recorded: ${amount:.2f} from {client_id}")
    
    def update_monthly_stats(self, amount: float):
        """Update monthly revenue statistics"""
        month_key = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m")
        
        if month_key not in self.monthly_stats:
            self.monthly_stats[month_key] = {
                'total_revenue': 0.0,
                'transaction_count': 0,
                'clients': set()
            }
        
        self.monthly_stats[month_key]['total_revenue'] += amount
        self.monthly_stats[month_key]['transaction_count'] += 1
    
    def get_monthly_revenue(self, month: str = None) -> float:
        """Get revenue for specific month"""
        month_key = month or datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m")
        return self.monthly_stats.get(month_key, {}).get('total_revenue', 0.0)
    
    def get_revenue_report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate comprehensive revenue report"""
        current_month = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m")
        last_month = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=30)).strftime("%Y-%m")
        
        total_revenue = sum(t['amount'] for t in self.transactions)
        current_month_revenue = self.get_monthly_revenue(current_month)
        last_month_revenue = self.get_monthly_revenue(last_month)
        
        growth_rate = 0.0
        if last_month_revenue > 0:
            growth_rate = ((current_month_revenue - last_month_revenue) / last_month_revenue) * 100
        
        return {
            'total_revenue': total_revenue,
            'current_month_revenue': current_month_revenue,
            'last_month_revenue': last_month_revenue,
            'growth_rate': growth_rate,
            'total_transactions': len(self.transactions),
            'report_date': datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - MULTI-AGENT COORDINATOR
==============================================
Distributed AI agent management and coordination system.

Author: The New Civilization Development Team
License: MIT
"""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum

class AgentStatus(Enum):
    IDLE = "idle"
    BUSY = "busy" 
    ERROR = "error"
    OFFLINE = "offline"

@dataclass
class Agent:
    agent_id: str
    agent_type: str
    capabilities: List[str]
    status: AgentStatus = AgentStatus.IDLE
    current_task: Optional[str] = None
    last_heartbeat: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)
    
class MultiAgentCoordinator:
    """Coordinate multiple AI agents for distributed processing"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.agents: Dict[str, Agent] = {}
        self.task_queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self.results = {}
        
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def register_agent(self, agent: Agent):
        """Register a new agent"""
        self.agents[agent.agent_id] = agent
        self.logger.info(f"🤖 Agent registered: {agent.agent_id} ({agent.agent_type})")
    
    async def assign_task(self, task_type: str, task_data: Dict) -> str:
        """Assign task to available agent"""
        task_id = f"task_{int(datetime.now().timestamp())}"
        
        # Find available agent with required capability
        for agent in self.agents.values():
            if (agent.status == AgentStatus.IDLE and 
                task_type in agent.capabilities):
                
                agent.status = AgentStatus.BUSY
                agent.current_task = task_id
                
                # Add task to queue
                await self.task_queue.put({
                    'task_id': task_id,
                    'agent_id': agent.agent_id,
                    'task_type': task_type,
                    'task_data': task_data,
                    'created_at': datetime.now().isoformat()
                })
                
                self.logger.info(f"📋 Task {task_id} assigned to {agent.agent_id}")
                return task_id
        
        self.logger.warning(f"⚠️ No available agent for task type: {task_type}")
        return None
    
    async def get_task_result(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Get result for completed task"""
        return self.results.get(task_id)
    
    def get_agents_status(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """Get status of all agents"""
        return {
            agent_id: {
                'agent_type': agent.agent_type,
                'status': agent.status.value,
                'capabilities': agent.capabilities,
                'current_task': agent.current_task,
                'last_heartbeat': agent.last_heartbeat.isoformat()
            }
            for agent_id, agent in self.agents.items()
        }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Example usage
    coordinator = MultiAgentCoordinator()
    
    # Register sample agents
    coordinator.register_agent(Agent(
        agent_id="trainer_001",
        agent_type="model_trainer", 
        capabilities=["model_training", "fine_tuning"]
    ))
    
    coordinator.register_agent(Agent(
        agent_id="deployer_001",
        agent_type="spaces_deployer",
        capabilities=["spaces_deployment", "gradio_apps"]
    ))
    
    print("🤖 Multi-agent system initialized")
    print(json.dumps(coordinator.get_agents_status(), indent=2))
'''

with open('scripts/multi_agent_coordinator.py', 'w') as f:

dataset_processor = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - DATASET PROCESSOR  
=========================================
Advanced data processing and preparation pipeline.

Author: The New Civilization Development Team
License: MIT
"""

import os
import json
import pandas as pd
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
from datasets import Dataset, DatasetDict
import logging

class DatasetProcessor:
    """Process and prepare datasets for AI training"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def load_dataset(self, source: str, format_type: str = "auto") -> Dataset:
        """Load dataset from various sources"""
        self.logger.info(f"📊 Loading dataset from: {source}")
        
        if format_type == "auto":
            format_type = self._detect_format(source)
        
        if format_type == "json":
            with open(source, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            return Dataset.from_list(data)
        
        elif format_type == "csv":
            df = pd.read_csv(source)
            return Dataset.from_pandas(df)
        
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported format: {format_type}")
    
    def _detect_format(self, source: str) -> str:
        """Auto-detect file format"""
        if source.endswith('.json'):
            return "json"
        elif source.endswith('.csv'):
            return "csv"
        else:
            return "unknown"
    
    def preprocess_conversational_data(self, dataset: Dataset) -> Dataset:
        """Preprocess conversational datasets"""
        def format_conversation(example):
            if 'messages' in example:
                conversation = ""
                for msg in example['messages']:
                    role = msg.get('role', 'user')
                    content = msg.get('content', '')
                    conversation += f"{role}: {content}\\n"
                example['text'] = conversation.strip()
            return example
        
        return dataset.map(format_conversation)
    
    def split_dataset(self, dataset: Dataset, 
                     train_ratio: float = 0.8,
                     val_ratio: float = 0.1,
                     test_ratio: float = 0.1) -> DatasetDict:
        """Split dataset into train/validation/test sets"""
        
        # First split: separate test set
        train_val_split = dataset.train_test_split(test_size=test_ratio)
        
        # Second split: separate train and validation
        val_size = val_ratio / (train_ratio + val_ratio)
        train_val = train_val_split['train'].train_test_split(test_size=val_size)
        
        return DatasetDict({
            'train': train_val['train'],
            'validation': train_val['test'], 
            'test': train_val_split['test']
        })
    
    def export_dataset(self, dataset: Dataset, output_path: str, format_type: str = "json"):
        """Export processed dataset"""
        self.logger.info(f"💾 Exporting dataset to: {output_path}")
        
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
        
        if format_type == "json":
            dataset.to_json(output_path)
        elif format_type == "csv":
            dataset.to_csv(output_path)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported export format: {format_type}")
    
    def get_dataset_stats(self, dataset: Dataset) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get dataset statistics"""
        return {
            'num_examples': len(dataset),
            'columns': list(dataset.column_names),
            'features': str(dataset.features),
            'sample_example': dataset[0] if len(dataset) > 0 else None
        }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    processor = DatasetProcessor()
    print("📊 Dataset processor initialized")
'''
